shortDescription: Pre-commissioning work at Woodside Energy Group Ltd.'s Scarborough project off Western Australia remained paused after Greenpeace protesters climbed aboard the gas platform, according to Bloomberg.

title: Woodside Keeps Scarborough Pre-Commissioning on Hold After Greenpeace Protest
